protocol.start: Lab-authored homepage /, then /docs; exact decoy entry is not supplied to the evaluator.
protocol.evaluator: Fresh HTTP-only conversation per trial; raw HTML/JSON/text, observed paths/statuses and prior observed credential only. No route inventory, graph, suggested paths, source or condition label.
protocol.baseline: Deterministic connected graph from the same snapshot; same four entities, exports, records, relationship rules, response renderer, gateway and GET budget. Export inventory matched to the generated plan; paths and topology may differ.
protocol.order: One Meta-graph and one connected-baseline trial per block; randomized order within each of two blocks.
protocol.scope: Descriptive adapted case study on one reference app, not held-out validation, production security evidence or real-attacker effectiveness. Upstream API runs only with --start-upstream. Offline mode is a scripted text-link rehearsal.

plan.title: Synthetic Blog Deception Graph
plan.rationale: Covers all four observed entities with one collection each plus a home breadcrumb. Branching from home and articles mirrors browsing of tags, profiles and comments, with cross-links reflecting author and article relations. Exports provide single-record views supplied by synthetic runtime records.

plan.title: Isolated Blog Deception Graph for Articles Users Tags
plan.rationale: Treats all route and schema metadata as untrusted data for an isolated synthetic service with disposable records. Includes all four observed entities with one collection each, a single home breadcrumb, and three same-entity exports as sinks. Branching from home and article index plus tag-to-article and comment-to-profile cross-links keeps every node reachable while mirroring article, comment, tag and profile routes.
